sas.summary: It’s fair to say that the Spurs should have won the championship four months ago. They led all five games of the Finals by at least 12 points, and made a couple of brutal mistakes in the closing seconds of Games 2 and 4. With Victor Wembanyama, Stephon Castle…

A season with big expectations got off to a rough start for Victor Wembanyama (1-for-13 against the Thunder) and the Spurs. After losing to Oklahoma City and Houston, they trailed the shorthanded Mavs (no Kyrie Irving or Cooper Flagg) late in the third…

The Spurs lost their first two games of the season, but have since won four straight. They’ve scored 119.2 points per 100 possessions over the streak, with Victor Wembanyama totaling 79 points over the last two games.

The Spurs’ winning streak is at eight games, over which they’ve ranked in the top three on both ends of the floor. They’re 8-2 for the second straight season, though they have a better point differential than they had through 10 games last year.

okc.summary: Over the last two seasons, the Thunder have had two of the top seven defenses of the last 30 years. They’ve lost some depth, but Jalen Williams is back to give the offense a boost.

The Thunder had a perfect start to the season, picking up double-digit wins over the Spurs and Nuggets. But then Jalen Williams suffered a gruesome right leg injury late in their win over the Clippers on Sunday.

Chet Holmgren (right knee injury) has joined Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace on the list of Thunder players who are out long-term, and Alex Caruso has missed the last two games with a sprained ankle. After a 4-0 start, Oklahoma City has dropped two by a…
Despite the injuries, the Thunder are one of five teams with only two losses. And they’re looking dominant again, having beaten the Grizzlies and Wizards by a total of 70 points over the weekend.

nyk.summary: The Knicks’ championship felt a little like that of the Mavs in 2011, except that this core is a much younger group. So, despite the departure of Mitchell Robinson, they remain the favorites in the East. The question is if they can again hit the level of…

The postseason vibes have not carried over and the champs are somehow 0-3 for the first time in seven years. They were handed a tough schedule for the first two weeks, but their game against the Magic on Sunday was very winnable. And they led by 10 with a…

The Knicks got their first win with a 40-point turnaround (from down 13 to up 27) against the team (Detroit) that swept them in convincing fashion last season. Another comeback win (in Chicago) followed, but they’re now 0-2 against the Sixers after an ugly…

After a 0-3 start, the Knicks have won five of their last six games to climb over .500 for the first time. They’re one of two teams (the Rockets are the other) that haven’t lost a game that wasn’t within five points in the last five minutes, and last week’s…

phi.summary: The stars have aligned in Philadelphia, and the Sixers are the most fascinating team in the league. In addition to the questions about health and durability, we all want to see how it all works on both ends of the floor.

The new-and-improved Sixers got off to a great start, going 3-0 (with wins over the Knicks and Cavs) before suffering a rest-disadvantage loss (without two starters) to the Pistons on Sunday. In their first back-to-back, they sat LeBron James in one game and…

The Sixers are 6-1, even though they have just the league’s 11th-best point differential (plus-3.9 per game). All six wins were within five points in the last five minutes, while the one loss (a rest-disadvantage game without Joel Embiid against Detroit) was…

The Sixers suffered their first loss with Joel Embiid in the lineup on Friday, unable to make another comeback from a huge deficit against the Cavs. But they got a big win in Detroit (avenging their previous loss) earlier in the week and remain at the top of…

bos.summary: With Jaylen Brown in Philadelphia, the Celtics enter a new era. But the structure of a team that’s ranked in the top five on both ends of the floor in each of the last four seasons is still here, and Mitchell Robinson should help them inside.

The Celtics had two big games in Week 1, they were both within five points in the last five minutes, and they split them. They blew a 22-point, second-half lead in Detroit and then held on to edge New York in their home opener.

The Celtics have won five straight games after blowing a 22-point lead in the season opener. They’ve mostly been taking care of business against bad teams, though they did need a rookie mistake from Mikel Brown Jr. and a Jayson Tatum buzzer-beater to edge the…

The Celtics lost in Houston (without Paul George) last week, but they’ll be playing for first place in the Eastern Conference on Tuesday. Having won their last two games by a total of 59 points, they’re in the top five on both ends of the floor for what would…

hou.summary: The Rockets had the West’s third best point differential (that of a 56-win team) last season, and they now have Fred VanVleet and Marcus Smart to address their biggest issues on offense. Steven Adams is also back and the Rockets could be the best candidate…

No team had a more impressive Week 1 than the Rockets. They clobbered the Mavs, edged the Spurs and beat the 2-0 Hawks on the road. We may have already seen the defensive play of the year, with Amen Thompson blocking Victor Wembanyama’s layup in the final…

The Rockets lost for the first time when they played without Alperen Sengun and missed some critical free throws in Dallas on Friday. But Sengun was back in the lineup the following night, when they beat the Thunder by 21 points.

After a West-best 7-1 start, the Rockets have lost two straight games to slide out of the top four in the conference. They still have a league-high six wins over teams that enter Week 4 with winning records. (No other team has more than four.)

cle.summary: The Cavs sacrificed some depth to add Peyton Watson, who gives them some much-needed length on the wing. They’re also getting a full year with James Harden after acquiring him with just 30 games left last season. The offense should remain potent, but the…

After blowing a 29-point lead in Philadelphia on Thursday (a call back to Game 1 of the Eastern Conference Finals in New York), the Cavs almost lost all of a 22-point, fourth-quarter lead against Brooklyn over the weekend. But they held on for their first win.

The Cavs are the only team with multiple losses in games they led by at least 15 points, having blown a 15-point lead in Atlanta on Thursday. But they’ve won four of their last five, having handed the Wolves their first defeat (in a game the Cavs trailed by…

The Cavs got an impressive win (without Jarrett Allen) over the Sixers on Friday, but were swept in a home-and-home set by the Thunder earlier in the week and lost another game to the Knicks on Saturday night. They haven’t found much consistency on either end…

tor.summary: The Raptors already looked like a team on the rise, and then they traded for Kawhi Leonard, who (when healthy) gives them exactly what they need on offense. If they can climb into the top 10 on that end of the floor, they could be one of the two or three best…

The Raptors were the sixth team in the 31 seasons of play-by-play data to get through their first two games without ever trailing. But Kawhi Leonard (knee swelling) was a late scratch for their showdown with the Wolves on Sunday, when they led for just 17…
After a 2-0 start with Kawhi Leonard, the Raptors have gone 1-3 without him. They had a Jekyll-and-Hyde two-game series with the Magic and then began a four-game trip with an ugly loss to the Lakers.

Still playing without Kawhi Leonard and missing at least one other starter in a couple of games last week, the Raptors went 2-2 on their first extended road trip of the season, with RJ Barrett leading seven guys who averaged double figures over the four games.

den.summary: The Nuggets lost two more critical rotation pieces with the departures of Peyton Watson and Tim Hardaway Jr. But they still have Nikola Jokić and Jamal Murray, and a healthier Aaron Gordon could more than make up for the departures.

The Nuggets led the Thunder for most of the first 36 minutes on Thursday, but they couldn’t hold on and scored just 84 points on 94 possessions (what would have been their worst offensive game last season) in the opener. They flipped the script in Game 2,…

The Nuggets were the first team to lose to the 0-3 (at the time) Warriors, allowing Golden State to have the most efficient offensive game (134 points on 96 possessions) for any team this season. But Denver got back on the right side of .500 with wins in New…

The Nuggets blew a double-digit, second-half lead against the Blazers last Monday, but they’ve won four of their last five games, with their best win of the season coming against Toronto on Wednesday.

det.summary: Jalen Duren is back and the Pistons have the opportunity to build off a 60-win season, their best year on both ends of the floor in the last 18 years. But the East is stronger and questions remain about their offense.

The Pistons had the best record (18-7) in games played between Eastern Conference playoff teams last season, and they’ve begun the new year with impressive wins over the Celtics, Heat and Sixers. They had a rest advantage for their wire-to-wire victory in…

The Pistons were outscored by 38 points (63-25) in the second and third quarters in New York on Tuesday, losing to the Knicks for the first time in almost 18 months. But they took care of business against the Hornets and Nets and are off to their best…

The Pistons dominated the Hornets (x 2) and Nets on a three-game winning streak, but couldn’t handle a step up in competition, falling to the Sixers and Lakers (without Luka Dončić) last week. They also announced Sunday that Jalen Duren (who’s been out since…

min.summary: The Wolves have changed direction once again, essentially swapping two big forwards (Julius Randle and Naz Reid) for a point guard. LaMelo Ball is here to make Anthony Edwards’ job easier, but we’ll see if he makes the Wolves a better team.

The Wolves are the second team in NBA history (joining the 2004-05 Jazz) to win each of their first three games by more than 20 points. And the third of those wins came against a team (Toronto) that had won its first two games by a total of 53.

Anthony Edwards scored 47 points in Cleveland on Monday … and was shut down (for multiple months) with a knee issue less than 24 hours later. The Wolves had their best offensive game of the season in a win over the Clippers on Friday night, but are 1-2…

The Wolves lost two of their first three games without Anthony Edwards, but they’ve since won four straight. They handed the Rockets their first home loss (and worst defensive game) of the season on Wednesday and then ended the Pelicans’ four-game winning…

lal.summary: LeBron James is in Philadelphia and Luka Dončić is the focal point in L.A. The Lakers have restructured their roster around the 27-year old, taking a big swing on Walker Kessler, who played just five games last season.
The Lakers are taking advantage of a soft start to their schedule, though they had to overcome an 11-point deficit against the Clippers and dig out of an 18-point hole in Utah.

The Lakers have split the first four games of a stretch of five in seven days. They beat the Clippers without Luka Dončić on Wednesday, but then blew a 25-point lead (with him back in the lineup) at Golden State two nights later.

The Lakers have won five straight games and have the best record in the Western Conference. They’re also 2-0 without Luka Dončić, having held on after blowing almost all of a 26-point lead against the Pistons on Sunday.

mia.summary: Giannis Antetokounmpo is here to get the Heat back into the top six in the Eastern Conference after four straight seasons of competing in the Play-In. It would be an upset if they’re not in the top 10 defensively for the 23rd time in the last 31 years, but do…
The Giannis Antetokounmpo Era in Miami is off to a rough start. The Heat are 0-3 for the first time since the 2007-08 season, when they finished 15-67, tied for the worst mark in franchise history.

After a 0-4 start, the Heat picked up double-digit wins over the Hawks and Pacers to avoid having to hit the panic button. Giannis Antetokounmpo totaled 55 points, 36 rebounds and 13 assists over the two wins.

The Heat doubled their win total last week, but the two wins came against the Clippers and Kings and by a total of just seven points. They came back from 20 points down in L.A., with Klay Thompson draining the game-winner with one second left in overtime.

ind.summary: Tyrese Haliburton is back and the Pacers are the GM’s favorite to be the most improved team in the league. They’ve got nowhere to go but up, but can they rise back to the level of title contender?
The Pacers had a disappointing home opener, trailing the Mavs by as many as 37 points on Friday. But they still had as many wins in Week 1 as they had through their first 18 games last season.

The Heat (2-4), Bucks (1-5) and Nets (1-5) are a combined 4-14, with three of those four wins having come against the Pacers last week. Indiana has lost four straight games, playing without Ivica Zubac for all four and without Tyrese Haliburton for the last…

Tyrese Haliburton remains out, but the Pacers almost beat the Hawks with only six guys on Monday, they ended their five-game losing streak in Memphis two nights later, and T.J. McConnell made his season debut over the weekend.

orl.summary: The Magic are giving it another go with the same core, hoping for better health and that new head coach Sean Sweeney can make an impact. They’re one of a handful of Eastern Conference teams that could potentially finish in the top four or slide down to the…

The Magic won a battle of 0-2 teams at Madison Square Garden on Sunday, giving head coach Sean Sweeney his first career victory. But, already missing Paolo Banchero, they lost Jalen Suggs to a non-contact knee injury with a little more than two minutes left.

The Magic were able to split their two games in Toronto last week, somehow registering the fourth most efficient offensive game for any team on Friday. But they’re 0-3 at home after coming up empty against the Celtics on Sunday afternoon.
Still playing without Jalen Suggs and Paolo Banchero, the Magic have lost four straight games, with the good news being that there are only six teams with winning records in the Eastern Conference.

atl.summary: The Hawks have added depth to a group that went 20-6 after the All-Star break last season and won more playoff games against the Knicks (two) than the Sixers, Cavs and Spurs combined. Some key players on this roster are still pretty young, with the potential…

A lopsided win or loss can skew a team’s numbers at this point in the season, and the Hawks had the most lopsided win of the season on Friday, beating the Hornets by 47 points. They also had an important win, edging the Magic behind two huge 3-pointers from…

The Hawks got a comeback win over the Cavs on Thursday, the end of their only stretch of five games in seven days. But they’ve lost four of their last five, with some inconsistency on both ends of the floor. This is the eighth straight year where they’ve been…

A four-game winning streak, including two wins over Trae Young’s Wizards, has the Hawks in the top four in the Eastern Conference. Three of the four wins were within three points in the final minute, but Onyeka Okongwu made some big plays (a running hook in…

phx.summary: The Suns were one of the league’s biggest surprises last season, but repeating that success (winning record and a playoff berth) will be more difficult now that the league knows how they play.

The Suns’ season got off to a dreadful start, as they became just the sixth team in the 31 seasons of play-by-play data to trail a game by at least 20 points before scoring. They got off to another slow start against the shorthanded Warriors on Saturday, but…

The Suns have played just four games over the first 13 days of the season, and they’ve yet to discover the defense that they made them one of the league’s biggest surprises last year. They allowed almost 129 points per 100 possessions in losses to the Thunder…

After a 1-5 start, the Suns have won two straight games, outlasting the Rockets (after blowing a 19-point lead) on Saturday. This is the same spot (3-5) they were a year ago, but might the West be stronger this season?

uta.summary: After four straight seasons in the bottom four in the conference, it’s time for the Jazz to flip the switch. Ace Bailey and Darryn Peterson are just getting started, but Jaren Jackson Jr., Lauri Markkanen and Keyonte George are getting paid to win games, and…
Flipping the “competitive basketball” switch is easier said than done, and the Jazz needed some clutch-time bounces to go their way against the Pelicans to pick up their only win in Week 1.

The Jazz have lost Jaren Jackson Jr. (torn MCL) for an extended period, and their only win came by a single point against the Pelicans. But they did go down to the wire against both the Grizzlies and Spurs last week, losing in overtime to San Antonio without…

The Jazz almost put their losing streak to an end in New Orleans on Wednesday, but Keyonte George’s game-winning jumper at the end of regulation came a fraction of a second after the buzzer. They’ve now lost twice in overtime, with their opponents (the Spurs…

por.summary: Damian Lillard and Ja Morant in the same backcourt is a thing that is happening in Portland. But it will be a serious challenge for new head coach Micah Nori (and the guards themselves) to make it work.

So far, so good in regard to the Blazers’ new backcourt. They’re one of six undefeated teams in the West, having clobbered the Suns on opening night and run past the Kings in the second half on Friday.

The Blazers went 1-1 in two games between unbeaten teams, outlasting the Lakers (on the road) in a barn-burner on Tuesday, but succumbing to the Grizzlies (at home) two nights later. This is their first 4-1 start since 2022-23, the last time they had Damian…

The Blazers won six of their first seven games for the first time in 27 years, and they ended a 12-game losing streak in Denver last Monday. But they then ran into Luka Dončić and Victor Wembanyama over the weekend, and their schedule will remain tough for…

dal.summary: Cooper Flagg enters Year 2 with a new coach (Dusty May) and Kyrie Irving back from his knee injury. The Mavs should be improved enough to compete for a Play-In spot in the West.

The Mavs got a good win in Indiana on Friday, but lost Cooper Flagg to a left shoulder injury along the way. Still, they managed to hang with the Spurs for 36 minutes without Flagg or Kyrie Irving the following night.

After a 1-2 start, the Mavs have won three straight games, handing both the Thunder and the Rockets their first losses of the season. Cooper Flagg missed just one game with his shoulder injury and has been the star of the streak, averaging 29.3 points, 6.7…

The Mavs allowed the Kings to get off the schneid last Monday, but they’re 6-2 with Kyrie Irving in uniform, with the two losses having come in Houston (on opening night) and San Antonio (by one point).

was.summary: The Wizards are one of the most fascinating teams in the league, set to integrate Trae Young and Anthony Davis with a young core that now includes No. 1 pick AJ Dybantsa. The new vets will raise the floor, but the returning youth will determine the ceiling.

The Wizards are 2-1, and the second win (Saturday in Chicago) was the second game of a back-to-back! That’s confirmation that it’s a new era in Washington, because they were 2-42 in the second games of back-to-backs over the last three seasons.

The Wizards have as many Emirates NBA Cup wins this season (they beat the Hornets on Friday) as they had in the first three years of the competition combined (1-11). With four of their six games having come against Milwaukee, Chicago and (shorthanded)…

Anthony Davis played in the Wizards’ first eight games, but he’s missed the last two with a right ankle sprain. The Wizards have dropped three straight, losing both ends of a home-and-home set with Trae Young’s former team and getting clobbered in Oklahoma…

cha.summary: The Hornets made the second biggest season-to-season, statistical improvement in the last 30 years … and then changed direction, trading the engine of their top-five offense to Minnesota. They’ll be a very different team without LaMelo Ball, but the continued…

The Hornets are missing two starters (Coby White and Kon Knueppel), they’ve had the league’s least efficient offense, and they’ve been outscored by 35 points over their three games. But they’re 2-1, with a clutch win over the Heat (after losing a 23-point…

After a 3-1 start, the Hornets have felt the absences of Kon Knueppel and Coby White, struggling to score and losing three straight games. They’re 3-4 with the point differential of a team that’s 1-6.

Coby White and Kon Knueppel each made their season debut last week, but White has shot just 6-for-26 (23%) in his first three games and Knueppel played less than six minutes before re-injuring his left hamstring in the Hornets’ loss in Brooklyn. Two nights…

mem.summary: It’s not clear what the Grizzlies have here, other than a young frontcourt that could be the envy of a lot of teams if Zach Edey can stay healthy. Cameron Boozer was the favorite in the GM Survey to win Rookie of the Year, and his preseason showed why.

The Grizzlies are the most surprising of the league’s six undefeated teams through Week 1, even if they’ve only played the Jazz, Warriors and Kings. It’s their first 3-0 start since the 2017-18 season, when they started 5-1 and then went 17-59 thereafter.

Cam Boozer recorded his first career triple-double as the Grizzlies won a battle of unbeaten teams in Portland on Thursday. Then they clobbered the Kings (without Ty Jerome) to make this the second 6-0 start in franchise history. The first came 12 years ago,…

After a 6-0 start, the Grizzlies fell back to earth last week. They lost close games to the Pelicans and Pacers, and then got clobbered by the Thunder. And with the West off to a strong start, the losing streak has taken them from first to seventh place.

gsw.summary: The Warriors begin Stephen Curry’s 18th season with a rough, short-term outlook. They won just 37 games last year, Jimmy Butler, Moses Moody and Kristaps Porziņģis are all on the shelf, and Curry has never looked more mortal. But he remains a difference-maker…

The Warriors are 0-3 for the first time since 2007, when Kelenna Azubuike and Al Harrington were their leading scorers through three games. They had a shot to beat the Grizzlies on Friday, but shot 0-for-5 in the clutch, with Draymond Green also getting…

Cue the GIF of WWE’s The Undertaker rising up off the mat. After a 0-3 Week 1, the Warriors have won four straight games. The first three came against other teams — the Nuggets, Wolves and Lakers — with winning records, and their win over the Clippers on…

Stephen Curry is on a heater and the Warriors have won seven straight games, even though they’ve trailed four of them by double digits. They ranked 29th defensively over their 0-3 start, but are sixth on that end of the floor over the course of the winning…

lac.summary: The Clippers will begin the season without Brandon Ingram, Max Strus, Jordan Miller and Yanic Konan Niederhäuser, leaving Darius Garland with a pretty heavy burden on his shoulders. Continuing their streak of 15 straight seasons with a winning record will be…

The Clippers might be better than expected. They’re 1-2, but after opening the season with a wire-to-wire victory over the Kings, they were pretty competitive on the road against two undefeated teams (the Lakers and Thunder).

The Clippers faced the Lakers without Luka Dončić, the Wolves without Anthony Edwards, and the Warriors without Stephen Curry last week. And they lost all three games by double digits, running their losing streak to five games.

The Clippers lost a couple of nail-biters before finally putting an end to their seven-game losing streak on Sunday with a comfortable win over the Pelicans. They ranked 26th offensively prior, but then had the third most efficient offensive game for any team…

nop.summary: The Pelicans are running it back, despite winning just 26 games last season. They’ve added Bennedict Mathurin, but they’re set to return 12 players who accounted for 85% of last season’s minutes, the league’s fourth-highest rate. They should get improvement…

The Pelicans played three (seemingly) good teams close in Week 1, but they came up empty down the stretch in all three games. So they’re 0-3 for the second straight year, having been outscored by a total of just 10 points.
After a 0-4 start in which three of the losses came by a total of 10 points, the Pelicans have won two straight games by dominating the paint.

The Pelicans won four straight games and handed the Grizzlies their first loss last Monday. But the streak ended with a loss to the Wolves on Friday, and then they were on the wrong side of the Clippers’ second win on Sunday night.

chi.summary: No. 4 pick Caleb Wilson brings more excitement to Chicago than we’ve seen in a while. If new head coach Tiago Splitter can get this team to defend like his Blazers did last season, the young and athletic Bulls can get out and run … and overachieve.

The Bulls lost their first five quarters of the season (60 total minutes) by 58 points. But they came back from a 15-point deficit to win in Milwaukee on Friday, and they got a breakout game (30 points and 14 rebounds) from Caleb Wilson in a loss to the…

The Bulls are going through a tough stretch of schedule, and they’ve lost four straight games, really struggling to get stops. The league has averaged 111.9 points per 100 possessions, and the Bulls have allowed more than that in all six of their games.

The Bulls still have just one win (which came against the Bucks), having lost their last seven games by an average of 16.3 points. But they did hang around with the Sixers for all 48 minutes on Sunday afternoon.

bkn.summary: The Nets’ most important players are the young ones, but the veterans they brought in (starting with Julius Randle) should make them a better team. There’s a ton of room for improvement on offense, where they scored 1.5 fewer points per 100 possessions than…

The Nets are one of two teams (the Pelicans are the other) that are 0-3 for the second straight season. Last year, their first win came in Game 8 in Indiana, where they’ll play Game 6 this year, having already lost to the Pacers at home

They blew a great opportunity in Boston earlier in the week, but the Nets finally got their first win on Sunday, taking advantage of the shorthanded and struggling Pacers. It’s the second straight year that they got their first win of the season in Indiana.…

The Nets got their second win of the season on Wednesday, avenging their opening-night loss to Charlotte with their best offensive performance (114 points on 94 possessions) of the season. But they blew a 17-point lead in Atlanta and got clobbered in Dallas…

mil.summary: The Bucks are rebuilding, and the Antetokounmpo trade (along with the No. 10 pick) gave them some young pieces to build around. More pieces can be acquired between now and the deadline if other teams are interested in the vets remaining on the roster.

The Bucks had fourth-quarter leads in each of their first two games, and they were tied with the Sixers late in the third quarter on Saturday. But they haven’t been able to close the deal and are one of four winless teams in the East.

The Bucks got off the schneid with a comeback win over the Pacers last Monday. But they then lost games to the Rockets and Cavs by a combined 57 points, allowing almost 130 per 100 possessions in both.

The Bucks erased a 22-point deficit in Boston on Wednesday and had a 15-point lead against the Raptors two nights later. But they’ve been unable to put four quarters together and have lost six straight games, tying the worst 10-game start in franchise history.

sac.summary: Darius Acuff Jr. is the focal point as the Kings begin to turn the page. They parted ways with DeMar DeRozan and Russell Westbrook this summer, but Zach LaVine (expiring contract) and Domantas Sabonis (two more years on his deal) are still here.

Before last week, the Kings’ first seven games looked like one of their easiest stretches of the season. But they’ve been unable to crack the win column thus far, though losses to the undefeated Blazers and Grizzlies were both within five points in the last…

With the Nets’ win in Indiana on Sunday, the Kings are the only team without a win. This is their first 0-6 start since the 1990-91 season, when they were led in scoring by Wayman Tisdale and eventually won 25 games.

The Kings got off the schneid with a comfortable win in Dallas last Monday, outscoring the Mavs by 36 points from 3-point range. But they then returned home and have lost the first three games of a seven-game homestand. This is the first time since 1990 that…
